second_failure_after_resolution.note: The cumulative difference is compared with what has already been carried or absorbed, so only the new EGP 200 is offered again.

failure_after_approval_before_payment.note: No recoverable debt is invented for money that never moved, and the change is no longer hidden by the fact that it did not.

insufficient_earnings.note: The remainder stays against the source month and is offered again for any later month, this year or another.
